Clearly she was shot from close range, the bullet entering the right temple and exiting from the left side. I would say that she was dead before her body hit the ground. Imagine my shock when I entered the library to find Mrs Jones lying dead on the couch, her face all but blown away by what appears to be the same gun that killed Mrs Brown. At the present the only people who seem to be involved are the gardener and his wife, the cook, and the maid along with Mrs Brown's niece Daphne Strachan and her fiancee Basil Phipps. I have asked them all to remain at the house for the present.".
